status: Completed expanded public-data validation; aggregate artifact prepared for review.
metric_definition: Derived Overall averages each page's available text/RO/TEDS components and excludes formulas without CDM. It is not an official leaderboard score. Native Omni TEDS weights tables; paired TEDS weights pages. Provider-dependent component coverage can confound derived Overall rankings.
bootstrap: 3000 whole source-group resamples; tie tolerance 0.05 point; exploratory multiple variants and strata.
runtime_amendment: After repeated OOM and stalled generation, all 78 pending pages used a fresh unchanged CLI process with a 90-minute active wall budget, including model startup. One dense newspaper was deferred to the end. After another reboot, elapsed budget accounting was persisted every 30 seconds; the interrupted final page used a retrospectively disclosed conservative 3600-second allocation and only 1800 seconds remained. Computer-off downtime was excluded; no fresh budget was granted. The runtime amendment was not preregistered. Failures remain explicit empty predictions; no speed improvement is claimed.

drdocbench.cost_limit: Counts are unique pages, not all model/block invocations. OOM retries, interruptions and process startup add cost. PRE savings are simulated; POST and empty-text fallback still require extraction.
drdocbench.sampling_limit: Known-book page holdout; books overlap earlier experiments.
drdocbench.native_table_coverage_limit: Native Dr TEDS omits some GT tables when compatible predicted table markup is absent; missing records are not zero scores. Compare coverage and equal-component support before ranking providers.

omnidocbench.cost_limit: Counts are unique pages, not all model/block invocations. OOM retries, interruptions and process startup add cost. PRE savings are simulated; POST and empty-text fallback still require extraction.
omnidocbench.sampling_limit: Balanced English diagnostic sample: 40 tables, 40 formula-without-table, 40 other. Filename-inferred groups do not prove unseen original books; not a full-benchmark estimate.
